summary: StoryFy Admin Portal Phase 1 - All critical features tested and working. Backend APIs (21 tests) passed 100%. Frontend UI flows tested successfully including login, dashboard stats, creator management, user suspend/activate, and limits adjustment.

ui_bugs.issue: Error toast shows 'Failed to execute json on Response: body stream already read' instead of the actual 403 error message 'Admin access required' when non-admin tries to login. Fix was applied but CDN caching may be serving old version.

admin_login_page.details: Page loads with shield icon, Admin Portal title, email/password inputs, and submit button. All data-testid attributes present.

admin_login_with_valid_credentials.details: Login with admin@admin.com/admin123 succeeds, redirects to /admin-access/dashboard, shows 'Admin access granted' toast

admin_login_with_non_admin_credentials.details: Login with testapi@test.com/password123 correctly blocked (403), but error toast message not user-friendly

admin_dashboard_stats.details: Dashboard shows platform stats: Total Users (10), Creators (9), Active 7d/30d, Stories (8), Episodes (7), Limits Used, Storage

creator_management_page.details: Table shows all 10 users with columns: User, Role, Status, Limits, Stories, Episodes, Storage, Actions

suspend_user.details: Clicking Suspend changes user status to 'suspended', shows 'User suspended' toast, button changes to 'Activate'

activate_user.details: Clicking Activate changes user status back to 'active', shows 'User active' toast

adjust_limits_dialog.details: Limits dialog opens with current balance, amount input, reason textarea, Cancel and Apply buttons

adjust_limits_submission.details: Submitting +100 limits shows 'Limits updated' toast, balance updated in table

admin_logout.details: Clicking Logout removes admin_token and redirects to /admin-access/login

navigation_links.details: Dashboard and Creators nav links work correctly, current page highlighted in cyan

action_items: MINOR: AdminLogin.js fix was applied to correctly parse error response before checking response.ok, but CDN caching may need clearing or wait for cache expiry
critical_code_review_comments: Admin routes use secret path 'admin-9821' which is good but consider env variable for easier rotation
Admin token stored in localStorage as 'admin_token' - separate from regular 'token' which is correct
Role-based access control working correctly - require_admin dependency properly rejects non-admin tokens with 403
seed_data_creation: None - used existing users and admin account
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin Portal Phase 1 complete. All APIs working: POST /api/admin-9821/login, GET /api/admin-9821/stats, GET /api/admin-9821/users, PATCH /api/admin-9821/users/status, POST /api/admin-9821/users/limits. Frontend routes: /admin-access/login, /admin-access/dashboard, /admin-access/creators. Admin user backfilled via ADMIN_EMAIL env var. Non-admin users correctly get 403 on all admin endpoints.
